claim: The BBB reports a pattern of complaints against Piper and Ivy concerning non-delivery issues.
counterpoint: BBB reached out to the business in January 2022 to obtain information about the complaints.

claim: A TrustRadius review explicitly notes that Printfection has ‘turnaround times are long.’
counterpoint: Despite the long turnaround comment, the review still gives Printfection a 7 out of 10 overall score.

claim: Blogger Maya Kern announced that a November 20th product launch would have delayed shipping because launch items were still in the warehouse and queued for check-in.
counterpoint: The post attributes the delay to an unusually high holiday processing volume (warehouse check-in queue).

claim: Swag Off Road’s customer service page states that if the company discovers a delay in a shipment, they will do their best to contact the customer.
counterpoint: The policy language is conditional (‘will do our best’), not an absolute delivery-time guarantee.

claim: PPAI research describes branded-merch industry sales as only ‘inching ahead,’ with growth small enough that it hasn’t relieved margin pressures or guaranteed profits.
counterpoint: Although growth is modest, the phrasing indicates sales are still increasing (i.e., ‘inching ahead’).

claim: Industry content (SnackNation) recommends quick-turnaround swag and promotional items as the solution when teams face tight deadlines.
counterpoint: The guidance implies quick-turnaround options exist, but does not quantify how common or fast those options are in practice.

claim: A Trustpilot review of Merchspirit (review by Luisa on 1/7/2025) explicitly states 'Sizing is off!' and that the reviewer bought two identical items hoping one would fit but could not return the other.
counterpoint: This is a single Trustpilot review (Luisa, 1/7/2025) on the merchant's Trustpilot page.

claim: A product review on Swag‑Kicks says the buyer ordered size 41 but received children's shoes instead.
counterpoint: The same reviewer also reports that the company required the buyer to pay return delivery charges when they asked about a return.
